thread:
Lina (Marketing): Hey all — need a small visual kit for the inference launch focused on nurture tiles + accessibility. Goal: three email hero variants, two social sizes, and a one-page benchmark summary that passes basic A11y checks. Comps in 48h, finals in 4 days.

Marco (Design): Sounds good. Any constraints on copy length or CTAs? Also do we need dark-mode variants?

Lina (Marketing): Copy: short punchy lines for Platform, Product, and Founders. CTAs: Request demo / Try API. Include dark-mode and high-contrast versions for email.

Zoe (Creative Ops): We'll deliver Figma components + flattened assets. I can include exported alt-text in a CSV and an accessibility checklist. Do we want dyslexic-friendly font fallback?

Lina (Marketing): Yes include a note for dyslexic-friendly fallback. Keep primary font Redwood Sans; fallback stack in Figma.

Marco (Design): Draft spec: Email hero 640x240 PNG @2x, Social wide 1200x628 PNG, Square 800x800 SVG, Benchmark 1-pager PDF + 1080x1920 story PNG. Provide light/dark/high-contrast color sets.

accessibility-bot: A11y checklist template attached: contrast ratios, alt text length, role semantics reminder.

Ruth (Legal): Quick reminder — no absolute savings claims in public assets unless backed by a source. Use conservative language. Send me the benchmark source for any comparative statements.

Lina (Marketing): Will avoid absolutes. I'll post the internal benchmark link in an hour for any sourced copy.

Marco (Design): I'll annotate each Figma component with which segment it's for and include suggested alt text for each tile. Will also add a toggled high-contrast frame.

Zoe (Creative Ops): I'll add export presets and a README for sales that explains how to swap numbers safely. Also will include a small localization sheet for en/ja/de.

Lina (Marketing): Perfect. Please tag me when comps land. If legal or a11y flags come up, we'll iterate quickly — timeline is tight.

Marco (Design): Starting comps tonight. ETA screenshots in ~16h.

Ruth (Legal): Standing by for the copy review. We can usually do quick sweeps within 24h.

Zoe (Creative Ops): Noted — I'll queue automated export jobs once comps are approved.
